name: Hotel Postwirt
beschreibung: Hotel Postwirt is centrally positioned in the historic village of Söll within the renowned Wilder Kaiser region. The 4-star hotel merges rich Tyrolean heritage with modern holiday amenities. Guests enjoy swift connections to the extensive slopes of SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental and a wide network of summer hiking trails. Highlights include a wellness area featuring a year-round heated outdoor pool and saunas, alongside an acclaimed regional restaurant.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Postwirt in central Söll in the Wilder Kaiser area features 4-star comfort, a year-round heated outdoor pool, saunas, fine dining, and easy access to SkiWelt.
